description: Parkings vélos is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Nicolas SOUAVIN. Location of bicycle car parks in the territory of Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines. Coverage: Nicolas SOUAVIN. The portal shows the English title as "Parking bicycles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Nicolas SOUAVIN. Its keywords include parkings, velo. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2018-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
